interface.name: denial_fingerprint_verifier_v1

description.summary: ask the user to touch the fingerprint sensor

interface.description:
A client asks Denial to verify the session user's fingerprint, as a phone does for an application's biometric prompt. Denial shows the sensor, runs the reader with the lighting and feedback it uses for its own lock screen, and reports the result. The client draws no sensor of its own.
Only the session's unlocked desktop verifies for a client. While the session is locked, a pending verification waits; it continues once the session is unlocked again. One verification runs at a time: a newer one, from any client, ends the older with done(cancelled).
A match proves only that an enrolled finger touched the reader while the verification was pending. It is never an unlock.

request.name: verify
request.description: A host without a usable reader ends it at once with done(unavailable).

interface.name: denial_fingerprint_verification_v1
interface.description: Events arrive until done. After done the object is inert and the client destroys it.

entry.name: cancelled
entry.summary: a newer verification replaced this one

request.name: destroy
request.description: A pending verification stops and the sensor is no longer shown.

event.name: ready
event.description: Sent each time the reader arms, including after a rejected finger.

event.name: rejected
event.description: The reader listens again; the verification stays pending.
